programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: Richard investigates Canada's best-known mysteries, the Oak Island treasure. Also known as the money pit, the site has become one of the world's deepest and most costly archaeological digs. Richard meets with several experts and researchers to discuss rumors that this deep shaft contains pirate plunderer perhaps the lost treasure of The Knights Templar. A skeptic born and raised in the area asserts the ‘money pit' is nothing more than a natural occurring sink hole.

programme.title: The Basement Office
programme.desc: The New York Post’s Steven Greenstreet sits down with Nick Pope to discuss the latest UFO sightings and the frightening modern day craft, the black triangle. Is there a Department of Defense cover-up?

programme.title: Morris's Paranormal Adventures UK
programme.desc: The team ventures into a massive 19th-century location with no known history of hauntings, only to discover they are far from alone. Joined by Moxley and Ming, Jay faces chilling encounters—including a terrifying hiss in the oldest part of the building—that make this investigation one of their most unsettling yet.

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered
programme.desc: During the '70s, our top scientists and astronomers sent coded messages into space with the hopes of getting a response from an extraterrestrial civilization. What they didn't anticipate was a speedy reply and an uptick in sightings around the world. We discuss who sent the message, its encoded response and the encounters humanity would experience in the near future.
